limitations: Virtual packet/controller execution, no radio or ESP32 scheduler
RAM table import does not test flash save/load
Fully learned means measured support at all 25 tested-range grid cells, not the entire 300-cell firmware table
Window comparisons are descriptive; learning is not assumed to improve response
Same learned fixture for both firmware versions; candidate-trained fixture provenance retained
coverage_level: Continuous production packet/controller simulation with one native process per ride; no radio, ESP32 scheduler or physical hardware
budget_status: Provisional engineering bands, including early/middle/late probes; not hardware fidelity proof

baseline.coverage_level: BLE-packet firmware ingestion + FTMS control + virtual motor; no radio or ESP32 scheduler
baseline.power_evaluation_signal: continuous effective plant output before sensor delay/noise
baseline.sensor_timing: independent acquisition, quantized forward to integration tick; immutable sample then delivery delay
baseline.initial_table: production-learned immutable fixture; RAM import, not flash persistence
baseline.pause_model: 60-second zero-cadence rider cue with bounded deceleration/reacceleration; real FTMS pause/start packets are status-only in current production
baseline.event_count_meaning: Production log observations and insertion attempts, not guaranteed accepted insertions; gain logs are sampled, not exhaustive lookup counts.

candidate.coverage_level: BLE-packet firmware ingestion + FTMS control + virtual motor; no radio or ESP32 scheduler
candidate.power_evaluation_signal: continuous effective plant output before sensor delay/noise
candidate.sensor_timing: independent acquisition, quantized forward to integration tick; immutable sample then delivery delay
candidate.initial_table: production-learned immutable fixture; RAM import, not flash persistence
candidate.pause_model: 60-second zero-cadence rider cue with bounded deceleration/reacceleration; real FTMS pause/start packets are status-only in current production
candidate.event_count_meaning: Production log observations and insertion attempts, not guaranteed accepted insertions; gain logs are sampled, not exhaustive lookup counts.

runs.overall_checks_scope: Whole ride plus early/middle/late probes, both plant and delivered-sensor signals
